description: 2MASS imaged the whole sky in the near-infrared J, H and Ks bands. These are the relative spectral response curves Cohen et al. (2003) derived for the 2MASS photometric system.
facility_description: The Two Micron All Sky Survey was a joint project of the University of Massachusetts and IPAC/Caltech, funded by NASA and the NSF.
notes: The 2MASS FAQ asks for the standard acknowledgement and gives Skrutskie et al. (2006) as the 2MASS reference. The RSR page (VI.4a) calls the Cohen et al. (2003) curves photon-counting RSRs that include PLEXUS-modelled atmospheric transmission; DetectorType left unchanged. The 2MASS FAQ separately says 2MASS Image Gallery images are public domain; licence here uses IRSA's general terms page, which covers public IRSA data.
